section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the Tripartite Influence Model and the impact of family appearance-related commentary and fat talk on body image and eating behaviors, particularly in women. The present study aims to extend this research by evaluating a partial sociocultural model of mindful eating in a college female sample, focusing on family fat talk, body appreciation, functional body appreciation, and mindful eating as key variables.
